Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

codriver 1.1.0

Enhancements

  • LLM prompts now report packages currently attached in the active R session and available for unqualified use. This replaces reporting library() calls found above the cursor, which may not have been executed, and gives the LLM a more accurate signal about the packages available to generated code.

  • New function codriver::codriver_info() collects the codriver version, active configuration and R/RStudio environment details.

  • New function codriver::codriver_last_request() returns the system prompt, user prompt, and raw assistant response from the most recent codriver request in the current R session.

Other

  • Increased test coverage to 100%.

  • Documentation updates:

    • New article Free API access,
    • Edited articles Getting started and Using codriver,
    • Edited intro texts and links to articles in README,
    • Added Umami statistics and GitHub Sponsors button to all pkgdown webpages,
    • Expanded package reference index,
    • Added automated spell checking.

  • Addressed some linting suggestions.

codriver 1.0.0

CRAN release: 2026-08-08

  • Initial CRAN submission.
